summary: Verified Wave 5 wallet→payout-address rename (EN + DE) and buyer public pages. Backend receipt/order/network-fees endpoints all pass. Frontend: sidebar, /wallet page (h1 'Payout addresses', all rename copy present, zero stray \bWallets?\b matches), Add-payout-address dialog (Address / Label labels, no 'Wallet address/name'), Settings → Security (Payout addresses + 'payout address protection'), Notifications 'Email categories' → config = 'Webhook, API key, payout address and profile changes', /payouts ('Settlement addresses' + 'By payout address'), command palette (Payout addresses + Add payout address), and DE i18n via Settings → Language flips /wallet to 'Auszahlungsadressen' + 'Auszahlungsadresse hinzufügen'. Public /receipt page: print btn calls window.print, refund-note starts with the exact required copy, merchant-contact block correctly ABSENT. Public /order page: help-line + merchant link → /hostbay, email/website/receipt links correctly ABSENT (brand has no contact). /pay?d=rNtQRX clean-checkout trust lines + non-custodial line present. SAFE MODE preserved (no writes / no OTP submissions).
critical_code_review_comments: Reviewer's checklist references merchant page URL '/wallet-security', but /pages/wallet-security.tsx is actually the public 'undo change' link (shows 'This link has expired' without a token). The merchant Wallet-security UI has been merged into Settings → Security (per /pages/wallet/security.tsx comment) — labels 'Payout addresses' and 'payout address protection' are visible there, so the rename intent is satisfied. Consider updating internal QA docs so future reviewers point to Settings → Security instead of /wallet-security.

On /pay?d=rNtQRX the coin-cost hints (data-testid=clean-checkout-coin-cost-*) are not rendered because a coin/network is already pre-selected on first render; picker screen not shown. Trust lines + non-custodial line ARE present — regression bar met. If the hints were expected on this landing, revisit conditional render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DE i18n does NOT switch by setting localStorage.i18nextLng='de' alone (window.i18next is undefined; app uses server-controlled preference). To switch language during testing, log in and click Settings → Language → Deutsch, then navigate. All Wave 5 rename + buyer-page acceptance criteria verified. /wallet-security is the public undo page (not a merchant screen).
